attr.title: PokeMMO
attr.desc: Unofficial port of PokeMMO for PortMaster-compatible devices. PokeMMO is a fan-made multiplayer online game that brings together various Pokémon generations in a single MMO experience. Includes a launcher menu to download/update the official client, console, small and Android UI modes, a joystick mapper and shaders optimized for low-end GPUs.
attr.inst: Launch the port and select 'PokeMMO Update' in its menu to download the official PokeMMO client (internet required). A Pokémon Black or White (v1) ROM is required: copy it to ports/pokemmo/roms/pokemon_black.nds. Optional ROMs unlock more regions: pokemon_firered.gba, pokemon_emerald.gba, pokemon_platinum.nds, pokemon_heartgold.nds. See the README for login and controls.
